def cells(fr,pred):

    for i,line in enumerate(fr.ascii.split('\n')):

    return out
def strip_pos(fr):
    cs=cells(fr, lambda i,j,ch: ch=='O')
    return (min(r for r,c in cs), min(c for r,c in cs)) if cs else None
def legend3(fr):

def timerY(fr): return len(cells(fr, lambda i,j,ch: ch=='Y'))
